summary.text: Justin Jones is a Democratic member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 52, where he has served since August 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Jones is on the ballot with Michele Vetter and Martez Coleman.

paragraphs.text: Justin Jones was born in Oakland, California, and earned a B.A. in political science from Fisk University.
His career experience includes working as an activist and as a fellow for the John Lewis Center for Social Justice, and he served on the board of directors of the Tennessee Healthcare Campaign.
Jones won the special general election for Tennessee House District 52 on August 3, 2023, and took office on August 17, 2023.
On April 6, 2023, the Tennessee House voted 72–25 to expel Jones, and on April 10, 2023, the Metropolitan Nashville Council voted 36–0 to reinstate him.
